Team — I reviewed the invoice lines and our revenue mapping. Notes: 
- INV-7892 (EMEA subscription renewal) recognized across May/June; VAT was booked to sales_tax_payable (EU rates).
- INV-7893 (professional services, one-time) should have a separate VAT bucket. The €2,000 discrepancy is a VAT reclassification, not principal.

Accounting treatment options:
A) Journal correction: debit sales_tax_payable €2,000 / credit AR applied to INV-7892 and debit AR for INV-7893 / credit sales_tax_payable — net effect moves VAT between invoices without touching revenue recognition schedules.
B) Apply a small credit memoto INV-7892 and re-apply to INV-7893 — operationally messier for collections history.

I prefer option A (journal) to keep revenue recognition intact. I'll draft the journal (GL mapping attached).

Attachment: proposed_journal_correction.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)
